title: Expose exact recent Photo statistics

verify.summary: Independent T3 verification reran the isolated controlled-clock API/oracle and UI probe, typecheck and Memory Bank lint. It proved exact active-Photo 1/5/60-minute counters, roles/failures, immutable admission lineage, visibility/restore behavior, five-second polling and the absence of stored or realtime statistics machinery.
Fresh independent T3 semantic verification found no admitted concern.
Autopilot closed TASK-108 after independent functional PASS and required T3 semantic-pass.

evidence_required: FT-012-AC-006 RED: the staff application has processing-health aggregates but no accepted active-Photo 1/5/60-minute new/unprocessed/processed/failed response or polling view; GREEN: one authorized direct query uses one observed_at, joins each active Photo only to its immutable admission state, returns the exact three windows and polls every five seconds without stored counters; decisive comparison: a controlled-clock independent SQL/oracle fixture covers both boundaries, every status, inactive/restore behavior and an extra revision row while access tests deny photographers; artifact: oracle inputs, response and focused redacted output under .tasks/TASK-108-T3-FT-012-W1/.
purpose: Provide the accepted recent per-SPA operational counters through one direct read instead of introducing metrics storage or realtime delivery.
success_outcome: Authorized operator/developer reads exact active-Photo 1/5/60-minute counters from one observation time and the staff view refreshes them every five seconds.
anti_goals: Do not store counters, buckets, metric events or refresh state.
Do not add WebSocket, SSE, a monitoring service or a new processing-state selector.
Do not implement Photo visibility mutation, restore-all or hard purge.

forbidden_scope: Production PostgreSQL and operator/default Photo or staff data
Processing state mutation, worker claims and inventory visibility/purge commands
Metrics persistence, background refresh, WebSocket and SSE
stop_conditions: Exact counters cannot be derived from existing Photo and immutable admission-state timestamps without new durable metric state.
The accepted rolling-window boundary or admission-state selector conflicts with current canonical processing lineage.
A role or time-boundary probe cannot use a controlled disposable database and complete cleanup.

constraints: Primary owner is inventory at src/face_moment/inventory/; processing state remains read-only and HTTP only adapts the result.
Anchor all windows to one server observed_at and count each Photo through only admission_pipeline_revision_id.
Return minutes 1, 5 and 60 in fixed order and poll exactly every five seconds.
Use synthetic controlled timestamps and active/inactive Photos in a disposable database.
invariants: Every result excludes inactive Photos and a restored Photo uses only preserved timestamps.
A later pipeline revision row neither replaces nor duplicates the Photo's counter contribution.
The implementation remains one direct PostgreSQL aggregate with no durable counter state or realtime transport.
verification_targets: An independent controlled-clock SQL/oracle matrix compares every category for 1/5/60 minutes at exact and just-outside boundaries.
API/HTML tests cover exact shape/order, operator/developer access, photographer denial, unknown SPA and five-second polling.
Schema/import inspection proves no counter table, metric event, background refresh, WebSocket or SSE was added.
